title: Haram
subtitle: This product contains an ingredient forbidden under Islamic Law.
description: BOTIA detects ingredients classified as Haram based on documented criteria.
why_body: Under Islamic Law, certain sources are explicitly forbidden — including pork and its derivatives, alcohol, blood, and food additives derived from any of these sources (Codex CAC/GL 24-1997). When BOTIA classifies an ingredient as Haram, the origin is clear and declared on the label.
what_body: The label declares an ingredient from a source explicitly forbidden under Islamic Law. The origin is not in doubt here — it is written on the label.
can_1: Detect ingredients classified as Haram under documented criteria.
can_3: Inform you about the status of declared ingredients.
cannot_1: Issue a religious ruling — it is not a religious authority.
cannot_3: See anything the label does not declare.
closing: Transparency is not certification. It is the right to know what the label says — and what it does not.
